text:
Predicates:
Roses(x) ::: x are roses.
GivenOutOnTV(x) ::: x are given out on TV.
Bachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
PortraysRealPeople(x) ::: x portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTV(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
BreakingBad(x) ::: x is Breaking Bad.
Time(y) ::: y is a time.
Monday(y) ::: y is Monday.
AtTime(y, z) ::: y is at time z.
OnMondayAt8PM(y) ::: y is on Monday at 8 pm.
Question:  
Based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? If roses are given out during Breaking Bad, then it is on Monday at 8 pm.

Premises:
∀x (GivenOutOnTV(x) ∧ Roses(x) → Bachelor(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (Bachelor(x) → PortraysRealPeople(x)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (PortraysRealPeople(x) → RealityTV(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTV(BreakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
∀y (OnMondayAt8PM(y) → AtTime(y, 8PM) ∧ Monday(y)) ::: If something is on Monday at 8 pm, then it is at time 8 pm and on Monday.

Conclusion:
(∀x ((GivenOutOnTV(x) ∧ Roses(x) ∧ BreakingBad) → OnMondayAt8PM(x))) ::: If roses are given out during Breaking Bad, then it is on Monday at 8 pm.
